headline: GOLD HOLDS AT $4,150 AHEAD OF AUGUST PCE — FED HIKE ODDS AT 51% AS MARKET AWAITS INFLATION VERDICT
snippet: Gold is consolidating between $4,110 and $4,177 on Wednesday September 30 ahead of the US Bureau of Economic Analysis August PCE Price Index release at 12:30 GMT — the Federal Reserve's preferred inflation gauge. Yesterday's weaker-than-forecast JOLTS data cut October rate hike odds from 70.9% to 51.5%, triggering gold's 1.4% rebound to $4,185; but the 10-year Treasury yield is holding near 5.24%, keeping pressure on the non-yielding metal. Core PCE is forecast to rise 0.3% month-on-month — a hotter print would revive October hike bets and extend the compression on developer valuations, while a miss would extend the rebound into Q4. For junior mining investors, this week's PCE and Friday's payrolls report are the defining macro pivot points before the October 15 FOMC.

headline: MONUMENT MINING FY2026: $68.8M NET PROFIT AT $4,280/OZ AVERAGE — CASH SURGES 138% TO C$109M IN RECORD YEAR
snippet: Monument Mining Limited (TSX-V: MMY) reported September 30 fiscal year 2026 results for the year ended June 30: net earnings of $68.80 million ($0.20/share), up 83% from $37.54 million in FY2025, on gross revenue of $165.72 million. The company produced 44,942 ounces of gold at a cash cost of $1,243/oz sold and a record average realized price of $4,280/oz — a $3,037/oz operating margin. Operating cash flow rose to $82.21 million and cash surged 138% to $109.56 million; a special CAD$6.91 million dividend was paid in January 2026. Monument's results are a textbook illustration of what record gold prices mean for a small, debt-free producer: $3,000+ per-ounce margins compounding into a cash-heavy balance sheet that simultaneously funds exploration and returns capital to shareholders.

headline: B2GOLD STRIKES TATTUK — NEW HIGH-GRADE ZONE AT 1,196M DEPTH AT GOOSE MINE; PRODUCTION GUIDANCE MAINTAINED
snippet: B2Gold Corp. (TSX: BTO) announced September 28 the discovery of a new high-grade gold zone named Tattuk at its Goose Mine in Nunavut, with drill hole 26GSE750Z2 returning 9.95 metres at 10.94 g/t gold from 1,196 metres depth — approximately 150 metres down-plunge from existing Nuvuyak mineralization — confirming the high-grade system extends at depth. Infill drilling at the Llama deposit returned highlight intervals of 21.23 metres at 19.12 g/t gold and 4.65 metres at 44.61 g/t gold, reinforcing resource confidence below the open pit. Despite an April 2026 crusher fire that required operational adjustments, B2Gold confirmed Goose Mine remains on track to meet 2026 production guidance — a new zone discovered during production suggests resource longevity at one of Canada's newest major gold operations.

headline: HUDBAY SNOW LAKE GOLD RESERVES UP 60% ADDING C$1B IN VALUE — COPPER PIPELINE TO 500,000 T/YR BY MID-2030S
snippet: HudBay Minerals (TSX: HBM) used Mining Forum Americas 2026 on September 28 to announce life-of-mine gold reserves at Snow Lake (Manitoba) rose 60% versus the prior plan, adding approximately CAD$1 billion in net asset value, projecting 185,000 ounces of annual gold production for the next five years plus 150,000 additional ounces versus the previous plan. On copper, management outlined Copper World, Cactus, and Mason targeting 303,000 additional tonnes of annual copper output by the mid-2030s, aimed at building toward a 500,000-tonne copper business. Critically, HudBay is using gold free cash flow to fund copper development — a structural shift from treating gold as a hedge — and the Snow Lake reserve addition creates immediate intrinsic value uplift on an already-profitable operation at current gold prices.

headline: LUNDIN GOLD MAPS 7 ECUADOR COPPER PORPHYRY SYSTEMS — SANDIA MRE DUE Q1 2027; 7-8% DIVIDEND AT SPOT PRICES
snippet: Lundin Gold Inc. (TSX: LUG) presented at Mining Forum Americas 2026 on September 28, detailing seven distinct copper porphyry centers identified across a 10-kilometre corridor in Ecuador near existing Fruta del Norte infrastructure — predominantly copper-dominant systems management described as potentially 'a multi-billion-tonne copper district over time.' A maiden resource estimate for the Sandia target is scheduled for Q1 2027. Simultaneously, Lundin Gold is returning a minimum 50% of free cash flow via dividends, generating a current yield of approximately 7-8% at spot gold. For retail investors, Lundin's exploration pivot toward a district-scale copper discovery adjacent to its operating gold mine adds a second long-term growth vector to what is already one of the highest-yielding gold producers on the TSX.

headline: CATL JIANXIAWO EIA REVOKED — BENCHMARK HALVES 2026 SUPPLY FORECAST TO 32,000T LCE; RESTART MAY SLIP TO 2027
snippet: Benchmark Mineral Intelligence cut its 2026 mined output forecast for CATL's Jianxiawo lepidolite mine in Yichun, China — the world's largest lithium operation by nameplate capacity at nearly 150,000 tonnes LCE/year — to 32,000 tonnes from 62,500 tonnes after the Yichun Environmental Bureau revoked the mine's Environmental Impact Assessment acceptance notice in early September, following over 70 public complaints about the disclosure process. A brief informal restart in July sparked the complaints; CATL restarted the EIA process on September 20, but full regulatory clearance could stretch into Q4 2026 or 2027. For retail investors tracking lithium juniors: removing 30,000+ tonnes of expected Chinese supply from 2026 estimates is a structurally bullish data point for Western developers — every delayed tonne at Jianxiawo is one fewer tonne that MinRes, Pilbara Minerals, and Core Lithium must compete against in the spot market.

headline: MINRES BALD HILL: SEPTEMBER QUARTER CLOSES TODAY — FIRST SPODUMENE CARGO FROM ESPERANCE IMMINENT
snippet: Mineral Resources Limited (ASX: MIN) guided for its first spodumene concentrate shipment from Port of Esperance in the September quarter — which closes today, September 30, 2026 — from the restarted Bald Hill lithium mine in Western Australia. The mine was placed on care and maintenance in November 2024 and restarted in May 2026 as lithium prices recovered; site crushing and mining have been underway since June and spodumene concentrate production has been underway from July, creating approximately 370 jobs. For lithium mining investors, first cargo from Bald Hill marks two simultaneous signals: MinRes has executed the restart on schedule, and a new incremental supply source from a tier-one Western jurisdiction is now actively competing at port at a moment when Chinese supply from CATL's Jianxiawo remains constrained.

headline: BRAZIL EXPLORER PROSPECTIVA HITS 9.72 G/T AU AT PICO DO JABRE — SÃO FRANCISCO COPPER-GOLD DRILL AT HALFWAY MARK
snippet: Prospectiva Resources Corp. (TSX-V: PSVA) released September 30 reconnaissance assay results from two gold projects in northeastern Brazil's Borborema Province — Pico do Jabre returning up to 9.72 g/t gold, and Desterro returning up to 6.09 g/t gold with a gold-bismuth spatial association suggesting a structural corridor of approximately 10 kilometres. The company's flagship São Francisco Copper-Gold Project is currently nearly halfway through its maiden drill program, with results to follow. Prospectiva began trading on the TSX-V in August 2026 as a district-scale Brazil explorer; for retail investors scanning TSX-V names ahead of maiden drill results, the high-grade rock chip sampling from two separate gold targets in an underexplored greenstone province provides genuine encouragement that the district is mineralised.

headline: KING GLOBAL ARIZONA: 22.6 G/T AU AND 601 G/T AG PEAK IN HISTORIC TAILINGS — AVG 3.85 G/T AU ACROSS 76 SAMPLES
snippet: King Global Critical Minerals Corp. (CSE: KING, OTCQB: KGLDF) reported September 29 systematic tailings sampling at the Golden Turkey deposit, Black Canyon Project in Maricopa County, Arizona: 76 samples on a 9-metre grid returned an average of 3.85 g/t gold and 76.2 g/t silver, with peak values of 22.6 g/t gold and 601 g/t silver; 17 samples exceeded 5 g/t gold, including six above 10 g/t. The company cautions these averages characterise only the sampled population. Black Canyon is a historic gold-silver-lead-zinc producer; the results confirm meaningful precious metal grades remain in tailings and will inform a formal resource estimate. For US-focused mining investors, Arizona's improved federal permitting posture under the current administration adds jurisdictional optionality to a high-grade historic-site story.

headline: KOBO RESOURCES KOSSOU GOLD: 19M @ 1.94 G/T AU AT ROAD CUT ZONE — NORTHERN DRILLING OPENS NEW GROWTH CORRIDORS
snippet: Kobo Resources Inc. (TSX-V: KOBO) reported September 29 diamond drill results from 14 additional holes at the Kossou Gold Project in Côte d'Ivoire, with the headline Road Cut Zone hole returning 19.0 metres at 1.94 g/t gold, and confirmatory results across the Jagger and Kadie Zones reinforcing extensive mineralisation across the project footprint. Northern drilling has identified new corridors for future resource growth. Côte d'Ivoire is a top-five African gold producer, and the Kossou area sits in a prospective greenstone corridor hosting significant deposits operated by Perseus Mining and Endeavour Mining. For retail investors tracking West African gold explorers, consistent multi-zone intercepts with additional untested northern targets are the building blocks of a first NI 43-101 resource estimate.
